Look! A den behind the falls.
Ring marks. All over the walls.
And a page from the Count Book!
It counts past nine. Ten. Eleven. Twelve.
Why did the counts stop at nine?
Hoo! You made it to Twin Falls.
We have two of everything here.
Two falls. Two trees. Two big rocks.
But our counts come out wrong too.
Help my pals. Then look for clues.
A round shape, in the mist.
It looks at us. It looks sad.
It is gone. We must find it.
A bun sat here. Now it is gone.
Who made the ring? Odd. Very odd.
I am Moss. I keep the Count Book.
We had six buns. Now we have five.
The count is wrong. It makes us muddled.
Pick a pal. Go and help.

The gate is shut.
Help the pals on the path.
A new path will come soon.
